notes: Portrait, shot from above and to the left at a steep angle in a Lyon bookshop, warm shop light, a glossy sleeve on the middle shelf reflecting a blue neon sign; three shelves, the bottom one a regional section on Lyon and its painters where nearly every spine reads, the middle one mostly old yellowed paperbacks with faded spines, the top one cut by the frame. French throughout. Titles as printed: 'Basilique Saint-Martin d'Ainay' carries 'L'âme romane de Lyon' as its subtitle on the same spine; the EDL picture book is labelled 'Lyon'; 'Dufy' is a monograph by Dora Perez-Tibi (the draft had the author as a title); Résistants à Lyon drops the small count line '2 824 engagements'; several old volumes read 'Histoire de Lyon' and are labelled once. Partial: 'Contes et légendes de Savoie', the brown spine on the middle shelf with its first word hidden. Left out: the old paperbacks on the middle and top shelves whose spines are too faded (Dictionnaire..., the 'Lyonnaise' blue spine, the 'Légende lyrique' cut by the frame), the grey Jules Lermina spine and the 'Antoine Chartres' spine (no readable title), the thin blue spine beside Lucien Bégule, the thin black 'Lyon, voyage au cœur de la Fête des Lumières' spine (not readable with confidence), the Alain Bouchet and 1791 imprimeur spines at the right edge, the white 'La Ville-Arlequin' spine, and the pale spines at the far left cut by the frame. Non-book item: a shelf tag '209' at the bottom. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 103), verified by an agent.
